name: An Echo of Nozdormu button is saved as Explode (#5469)
contract: Echo of Nozdormu 520937 ('Transforms your Explode into Echo of Nozdormu. @s:802174') is a passive bound to aura_ascension_pyromancer_lifecycle, whose apply calls AscensionPyromancer::Refresh (AscensionPyromancerAuras.cpp:54-55); Refresh also runs periodically. While the aura is active, Refresh learns every PyromancerEchoRanks entry with SpellLevel at or below the player's level with learnSpell(..., true) (AscensionPyromancer.cpp:366-369) and replaces every known Explode rank (chain of 800792) with the highest learned Echo rank through SetTemporarySpellReplacement (lines 370-372). At level 15 that is only Echo of Nozdormu rank 1 802174 (SpellLevel 11; rank 2 803407 is level 18). 802174 is never written to character_spell, so a button holding it must be saved as Explode 800792, the spell persisted_action_button reads from Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell; a button holding Explode itself is saved unchanged.

steps.label: The bar holds Echo of Nozdormu
The Echo of Nozdormu button is saved as Explode
